rule: union box of teacher map >= its imagewise 95th percentile; no GT/calibration; box on every image

unconditional_box.note: All-anomaly denominators count malformed, No, or missing boxes as zero. Conditional metrics require coverage. Center hit is box-center-inside-GT-box, not pixel-mask point accuracy; union box covers all components.
